title: Resurrecting iChat Audio and Video Conferencing
summary: A technical deep-dive into reverse engineering and recreating Apple's discontinued iChat application, specifically focusing on resurrecting its audio and video conferencing capabilities through modern implementation techniques.
problem_solved: Revives obsolete video conferencing technology from Apple's abandoned iChat for preservation and educational purposes.
why_valuable: Preserves important software archaeology while demonstrating how legacy protocols can be reimplemented using modern tools.
